pr_title: changefeedcc: Do not emit epoch resolved events.
pr_body:
Do not emit resolved events with unix epoch timestamp.

Fixes #72917

Release Notes: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/72932)

issue_context.title: changefeedccl: Avoid emitting epoch resolved messages
issue_context.body:
Checkpoint logic causes changefeds to emit Resoved messages with unix
epoch timestamp if the backfill takes long time.

review_comments: When would the empty timestamp actually happen?

Empty timestamp would happen when we are doing initial backfill, before we checkpointted high water mark.
What happens then is that we call maybeEmitResovled with empty resolved timestamp -- because that's the frontier when we decide to checkpoint backfilled spans.
Did we have any instances where the job wasn't cancelled?

You see above I added return `return errors.New("unexpected epoch resolved event")` -- so, normally, 
the job IS cancelled (that's what closeFeed does); but I want to make sure that that's the only error I allow,
and catch the above error if it happens.
